title: 第274章 ‘自由计划’行动开始
slug: 德黑兰杂货铺我的情报明码标价
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

消息很快顺着通讯网络层层下达。

土耳其，迪亚巴克尔军事基地。

三支全副武装的特种行动小组在停机坪前迅速集结。

没有冗长的战前动员，指挥官简单交代了任务目标和坐标后，所有人登车出发。

车队迅速驶出基地，直奔边境线。

与此同时，之前被卡西姆派到其他边境城市调查的相关人员，也全都接到了最高级别的集结指令。

所有人的目标只有一个。

巴扎尔甘。

一夜无话。

5月4日凌晨。

波斯湾海域，夜色浓重。

海风卷着咸涩的水汽吹过甲板。

“林肯号”航空母舰上。

飞行甲板上灯火通明，地勤人员穿着各色马甲，引导着战机进入弹射位置。

航空发动机的轰鸣声震耳欲聋，尾流喷射出幽蓝色的火焰。

随着弹射官猛地挥下手势，蒸汽弹射器瞬间发力。

一架F/A-18“超级大黄蜂”猛地窜入夜空。

紧接着，第二架、第三架……

随后，两个中队的“超级大黄蜂”相继升空，在航母上空完成编队。

随后，四架EA-18G“咆哮者”电子战机也顺利起飞，混入编队之中。

庞大的机群调整航向，直奔伊朗南部的海岸线。

航母作战指挥中心内。

舰队司令丹尼尔少将此时正站在巨型战术屏幕前。

屏幕上，代表美军机群的绿色光点正在快速向目标海域移动。

“长官，攻击编队已进入预定航线。”

“预计二十分钟后抵达格什姆岛和阿巴斯港上空。”

通讯军官大声汇报道。

丹尼尔点点头。

“命令‘咆哮者’小队，进入目标空域后，立刻开启全频段电子压制。”

“瘫痪他们的沿海雷达站和防空系统。”

“‘野猫’和‘枪手’随后跟进，摧毁他们所有高价值目标。”

“收到。”

丹尼尔拿起桌上的咖啡喝了一口，神色十分轻松。

这次行动是五角大楼亲自制定的，突袭伊朗沿海的关键雷达设施。

有四架“咆哮者”压阵，伊朗那些老旧的防空系统根本不堪一击。

等他们反应过来，他们的任务早已完成了。

同一时间。

德黑兰，格什姆岛革命卫队地下指挥中心。

艾哈里德双手背在身后，大厅里全都是密集的键盘敲击声和通讯兵急促的呼叫声。

Page (1/3)

The news quickly spread down the communication network.

Diyarbakir military base, Türkiye.

Three heavily armed special operations teams quickly assembled in front of the tarmac.

There was no lengthy pre-war mobilization. After the commander briefly explained the mission objectives and coordinates, everyone boarded the vehicle and set off.

The convoy quickly drove out of the base and headed straight for the border.

At the same time, relevant personnel previously sent by Qasim to other border cities for investigation also received the highest-level assembly instructions.

Everyone has only one goal.

Bazargan.

A night of silence.

In the early morning of May 4th.

In the waters of the Persian Gulf, the night is thick.

The sea breeze carried salty vapor across the deck.

Aboard the aircraft carrier USS Lincoln.

The flight deck was brightly lit, and ground crews wearing various colored vests guided the fighter planes into ejection positions.

The roar of the aircraft engine was deafening, and the wake sprayed out blue flames.

As the ejection officer suddenly waved his hand, the steam catapult instantly exerted force.

An F/A-18 Super Hornet suddenly burst into the night sky.

Immediately afterwards, the second, third...

Subsequently, the "Super Hornets" of the two squadrons took off one after another and completed the formation above the aircraft carrier.

Subsequently, four EA-18G "Growler" electronic warfare aircraft also took off smoothly and blended into the formation.

The huge fleet of aircraft adjusted their course and headed straight for Iran's southern coastline.

Inside the aircraft carrier combat command center.

Fleet Commander Rear Admiral Daniel was standing in front of the giant tactical screen.

On the screen, green light spots representing the US military aircraft fleet were moving rapidly towards the target sea area.

"Sir, the attack formation has entered the planned route."

"It is expected to arrive over Qeshm Island and Bandar Abbas Port in twenty minutes."

The communications officer loudly reported the report.

Daniel nodded.

"Order the 'Growler' team to immediately activate full-band electronic suppression after entering the target airspace."

"Disabling their coastal radar stations and air defense systems."

"Wildcats and Gunners followed, destroying all of their high-value targets."

"Roger that."

Daniel picked up the coffee on the table and took a sip, looking very relaxed.

The operation was personally orchestrated by the Pentagon to raid key radar installations off the coast of Iran.

With four "Growlers" holding the line, Iran's old air defense systems were simply vulnerable.

By the time they reacted, their mission had already been completed.

at the same time.

Tehran, underground command center of the Revolutionary Guards on Qeshm Island.

Aharid put his hands behind his back, and the hall was filled with the intensive sound of keyboard tapping and the urgent calls of the communication soldiers.
